title: Retained Layers rows and selection presentation
runs_shape: identical to PHASE14_RESULTS.json: list of {workload, run, metrics}
goal: selection change updates affected Layers rows instead of rebuilding the whole row tree
outcome: GPUI pins retention to the entity boundary and dirtying propagates to ancestors, so O(changed rows) element construction is not reachable without inventing a framework. Phase 15 delivers O(changed rows) presentation derivation, per-row presentation flags and precomputed row element ids, and honest counters; the Layers rebuild at 10k got 12.9%/9.0% cheaper while a new measured 1.56 ms O(rows) sweep was added to the shell render path.

gpui_retention.cached_scope: the rendered subtree of one entity-backed view; with a cached style render() is not called during layout (view.rs:281, view.rs:423-445)
gpui_retention.reuse_condition: bounds, content_mask and text_style equal, view not in window.dirty_views, and window.refreshing is false (view.rs:466-530)
gpui_retention.invalidation_direction: notify marks the view and all ancestors dirty, never descendants (window.rs:2148-2161)
gpui_retention.nested_invalidation: a re-rendering cached view sets window.refreshing, which forces every nested cached child to re-render (view.rs:501-511 vs view.rs:489)
gpui_retention.per_child_memoization: none inside a view's render(); element ids reuse layout and scene state, not construction
gpui_retention.consequence: rows are plain divs inside one LayersView entity, so a selection change must rebuild all of them; per-row entities would not help because notifying a row dirties Layers, which re-renders every sibling row
gpui_retention.achieved_instead: O(changed rows) presentation derivation (row_presentation_updates) while GPUI still rebuilds the subtree (layers_row_construction)

instrumentation.layers_projection_rebuild: document walk + row projection rebuild (structure change only)
instrumentation.layers_selection_sync: timer for apply_selection, the O(rows) presentation sweep (new in phase 15)
instrumentation.layers_selection_update: selection-change events applied to the projection
instrumentation.row_presentation_updates: rows whose presentation flag flipped (new in phase 15; the O(changed) quantity)
instrumentation.layers_row_construction: rows constructed inside render(); O(N) per rebuild, NOT equal to row_presentation_updates
instrumentation.layers_tree_build: timer around LayersView::render (construction only; excludes layout, prepaint, paint, GPU)
instrumentation.shell_render_build: timer around AppShell::render, now including the selection sweep
instrumentation.inspector_projection: inspector projection timer (unchanged, untouched this phase)

validation.known_note: block v0.1.6 future-incompatibility warning from a transitive dependency (pre-existing)

runtime_verification.mode: normal application, diagnostics disabled, real CGEventPost mouse input (not the workload driver)
runtime_verification.screenshots_note: all three shots reviewed at 1:1 logical scale after capture; visual pass corroborates the programmatic pixel checks and does not replace them (single sample per interaction, no intermediate frames, hover or timing evidence)

screenshots_visual_findings.shot1: normal editor: title bar, tool palette with Select active at 100% zoom, PAGES and LAYERS rail (Landing/Editor/Features/Mobile), four artboards, Inspector 'No selection'; no LAYERS row washed
screenshots_visual_findings.shot2: exactly one LAYERS row (Landing) carries the accent wash; artboard outlined with eight handles; Inspector shows Landing position/size (X 0, W 430), Layout, Appearance, Effects, Typography, Export
screenshots_visual_findings.shot3: all four LAYERS rows carry the accent wash; four artboards outlined; Inspector reads '4 objects selected - Style changes apply to selection'

runtime_verification.screenshots_visual_regression_check: no layout shift, clipped row, missing glyph, stray debug overlay or accent wash on an unselected row in any shot

limitations: the 10k selection rebuild still constructs 10,000 rows 59 times per run
the O(changed) presentation diff needs one linear sweep of the retained rows: 1.56 ms at 10k, measured as layers_selection_sync
all numbers are debug-build construction timers, not end-to-end frame times; no FPS claim
paint and layout of 10k rows sit outside every timer here
selection is transient editor state and is never serialized
remaining_bottleneck: full row-tree rebuild: 22.6 ms per selection change at 10k objects (~226 ns per row), with paint/layout on top; the Inspector's broad invalidation is a separate untouched problem
recommended_next_phase: Phase 16 - virtualize the Layers row list (build only rows in the scroll viewport, keep intrinsic height from tree_height), and decide whether to replace the 1.56 ms membership sweep with an ObjectId -> row index or a 64-bit membership prefilter
